articles.title: Binance withdraws Greek MiCA bid but vows to remain in Europe
articles.snippet: The crypto giant must find a home base in the EU by July 1 or regulators will force the company to shut down operations for millions of regional users.

articles.title: CoinDesk 20 performance update: Aave (AAVE) gains 5.9% as index moves higher
articles.snippet: Internet Computer (ICP), up 2% from Tuesday, joined Aave (AAVE) as a top performer.

articles.title: YZi Labs ends proxy war with BNB treasury company CEA Industries
articles.snippet: Partner Alex Odagiu will serve as an interim president, pending a search for a new chief executive, while head of YZi Labs Ella Zhang and Matthew Roszak also appointed directors of CEA.

articles.title: Michael Saylor should halt Strategy's bitcoin buys, says CryptoQuant
articles.snippet: CryptoQuant says the cash cushion behind Strategy's STRC has thinned from seven years of coverage to 14 months, and buying BTC at cycle tops has left the company with a $10.6 billion paper loss.

articles.title: AI chipmaker Cerebras down 11% after first public earnings report
articles.snippet: While revenue was up 92% from year-ago levels, the company forecasted a lower core gross margin next quarter.
